playstyle.identity: Tryndamere is a splitpushing melee carry who cannot die during his ultimate. He builds fury for crits and is one of the best 1v1 duelists in the game.
playstyle.howToPlay: Passive builds fury for crit chance. Q consumes fury to heal (more heal at low HP). W slows and reduces AD if enemies face away. E spins through enemies (reduced CD on crits). R makes you unable to die for 5 seconds. Split push, R to survive, clean up.
playstyle.powerSpikes: Tryndamere spikes at level 6 with his immortality and with Kraken/Navori. He's a late-game splitpush monster.

passive.name: Battle Fury
passive.summary: Build fury for critical strike chance.
passive.details: Tryndamere gains fury when attacking and being attacked. More fury gives higher critical strike chance.

abilities.name: Bloodlust
abilities.summary: Passive: gain AD based on missing health. Active: heal and consume fury.
abilities.details: Passive: Tryndamere gains bonus AD based on missing health. Active: He consumes fury to heal, healing more at low health.

abilities.name: Mocking Shout
abilities.summary: Slow enemies facing away and reduce their AD.
abilities.details: Tryndamere shouts, reducing nearby enemies' attack damage. Enemies facing away are also slowed.

abilities.name: Spinning Slash
abilities.summary: Spin through enemies dealing damage; cooldown reduced by crits.
abilities.details: Tryndamere spins through enemies, dealing damage. Critical strikes reduce the cooldown.

abilities.name: Undying Rage
abilities.summary: Become unable to die for 5 seconds.
abilities.details: Tryndamere becomes unkillable for 5 seconds, unable to drop below 1 HP no matter how much damage he takes.
